about: All of MassDOT District 3 (EPSG:26986 box 128000,856000,206000,946000) at 20 m for every catalogue storm (docs/proto/parity/catalog): display runs for the tiled site replays with the frozen settings of run_d3_sep2023_20m (CN x 0.88, LF_PARITY=1, 10-min snapshots + solver velocity frames) plus terrain fix T2 (LF_NOTCH_FIX=1, LF_CHAN_ENFORCE=1; docs/proto/terrain/TERRAIN.md, adopted for displayed runs by the owner 1 Nov 2026), no scoring. Runner: proto/turing/run_plan_display.slurm; outputs in $LF_WORK/run_<storm>_proto_d3t2_<storm>/out for pack_site.slurm (NAME=d3t2_<storm>).
